title: Chess.com Accuracy Drift After Midnight
dataSources: Steam activity and achievements (`steam:activity`), Chess.com games (`chesscom:game`), online-go matches (`ogs:game`), and poker home-game hands or settlements (`pokerhome:session`).
app: Gaming and play telemetry from Steam, Chess.com, Online-Go servers, and poker home-game logs sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and export files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=chesscom:game
| search accuracy_pct=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(accuracy_pct) as avg_accuracy_pct count as games by _time after_midnight
| sort - _time
description: Tracks post-midnight chess accuracy over time and breaks it out by after-midnight flag.
value: A late-night split often reveals when fatigue is turning games into training data for bad habits.
implementation: Send post-midnight chess accuracy events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of post-midnight chess accuracy by after-midnight flag.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how post-midnight chess accuracy changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
